## Outcome

What this pull request changes, and which chapter or decision it serves.

## Verification tier claimed

One of: planned, draft, locally verified, GitHub Actions verified, consumer
verified.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Implementation and the relevant documentation agree.
- [ ] The positive check ran and met its expectation.
- [ ] The deliberate negative check ran and failed as intended.
- [ ] Evidence is linked or recorded in `docs/evidence/`.
- [ ] Permission-sensitive changes (tokens, secrets, `permissions:`, action
      pins) are called out for review.
- [ ] Fixtures and disposable edits are restored.
- [ ] Recovery is described for anything this change can break.

## Out of scope

What this pull request deliberately does not change.
